# Fungi of Finse

<!-- badges: start -->

<!-- badges: end -->

This is Hilary Rose's final exercise for the Open Science 2026 course. Use this repo to see how Finse fungi are documented in GBIF. Data are from GBIF <https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.7q6u65>.
